fey-tormentor.summary: Cruel fey magic: slow and weaken a group of foes, and curse with Hex.

Faerie Time Warp.summary: Bonus Action: up to three creatures you see within 60 ft make a WIS save (DC 8 + PB + the ability you raised); on a failure each loses 10 ft of Speed and takes −2 AC until your next turn ends. Once per Long Rest.

Hag’s Hex.summary: Hex is always prepared (Bestow Curse too from level 5), each castable once per Long Rest without a slot, or with your slots. The ability you raised casts them.
